meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Where loans are booked and where the money is used, state by state: credit by place of sanction and by place of utilisation, March 2026
meta.note: RBI BSR-1 table 1.3 (DBIE 1134): outstanding credit of scheduled commercial banks (including RRBs) by the state of the branch that sanctioned it and by the state where it is used, ₹ lakh crore. Credit used in a state = sanctioned and used there + sanctioned elsewhere and used there.
